answer: Pull a jury. Make each member sign the claim without seeing the others. Slash any signature that differs. Reset the identity's standing the moment it links to another account. Bleed standing every idle epoch. Now watch a farm keep five agents in sync without sharing a wallet, a host or a funding trail. One slip links them and the record resets. Idle clones decay like cut timber. A falcon dive is quick; a farm is slow, because every juror it fields is a separate bill and a separate point of failure. A clean jade record is the only asset worth holding.
